answer: Require every agent identity to lock a scarce, slashable deposit before submitting jobs or earning reputation. A falcon-like operator creating many Sybils must fund each lock; if independent auditors prove coordinated fake work, the system confiscates deposits and erases reputation. The ripple is a direct cost: attacks tie up capital in advance and risk losing it, rather than gaining strength merely by minting names. A willow account is no exception.
